summary: BALDERMOEN AS (org. no. 814 349 322) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-10-25. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.6 m and net income was -NOK 1.7 m. CEO: Øyvind Hartveit; board chair: Andreas Jul Røsjø; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
